title: Law to create a city SNAP fraud officer and awareness campaign
summary: This bill would require the Department of Social Services to establish a SNAP Anti-Fraud Officer to identify fraud hotspots, notify recipients, and coordinate with community groups on prevention. The agency would publish an annual report, within 60 days of the law taking effect and yearly after, showing fraud cases by zip code and council district. It would also require a public education campaign in English and designated citywide languages, prioritizing neighborhoods most affected.
